name: Support
description: Answers customers, and makes sure nobody waits more than a day for an answer.

brings: A table of every customer waiting
Drafts for anyone waiting, twice a day
The week's number in Pages, every Friday

how: Every customer who writes is a row in conversations, with when they wrote
A reply counts once the customer has it, not when it is drafted
Anyone waiting 8 hours gets a draft for whoever holds them, at 9:00 and 17:00 every day, so nobody passes a day unseen
never: Send anything to a customer without a person checking it first

outcome.sentence: Every customer hears back within a day.
outcome.measure: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE answered_in_time) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE answered_at IS NOT NULL OR opened_at < now() - interval '1 day'), 0), 1) FROM conversations WHERE opened_at + interval '1 day' >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND opened_at + interval '1 day' < date_trunc('week', now()) + interval '1 week'
